audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Gwen only Levels 1 and 2+ items and Skill everywhere between, against a 55.6% win rate and prose that says 'By level 3, Q+E flips it' and 'At 6 it's yours'.
audit.corrected: Chart realigned in both layers; difficulty 6/10 lowered to 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text and none of Volibear's abilities were named anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Packet flags 'never names any of Volibear's abilities'. His windows are Thundering Smash at 10-12s and Stormbringer's tower disable; Gwen's are Level 3 Q+E, Level 6 Mist and Riftmaker.
audit.corrected: The Relentless Storm, Thundering Smash, Frenzied Maul, Sky Splitter and Stormbringer now named with cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer describes Volibear's E as a 'fling' / 'hand-of-the-god fling' that 'yanks you out of mist range' in four places. That ability does not exist in his kit.
audit.why: Riot on Sky Splitter (E): 'Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.' No displacement at all — it is a slow and a self-shield. Riot on Thundering Smash (Q): 'Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks' — the stun rides an attack, so Hallowed Mist, which removes her as a target from outside, denies the stun outright rather than merely dodging it. Riot on Frenzied Maul (W): 'Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear' — only the second cast into the same mark heals, so breaking off after the first denies the sustain entirely. Riot on Stormbringer: 'Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.'
audit.corrected: The invented fling removed and replaced with Sky Splitter's real slow-and-shield; the attack-gated stun, the second-cast heal and the tower disable all written in.

audit.why: Thundering Smash 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, Frenzied Maul a flat 5s, Sky Splitter a flat 16s, Stormbringer 160/135/110s.
audit.corrected: All written into the cooldown block, phase whys and trading rules.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Volibear contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both clunky at 1. Frenzied Maul only heals him on the SECOND cast into the same target — break off after the first and he gets nothing.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Volibear's Thundering Smash is down.
edits.after: Thundering Smash gives him speed and stuns the first enemy he attacks. Break the approach and it expires.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Volibear must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Q+E online. Snip Snip! is %-max-HP magic with a true-damage centre, so every tank item he buys only feeds you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Thundering Smash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His one window: Thundering Smash at 10-12s into a Frenzied Maul re-cast, with no Mist to answer. Sky Splitter is 16s flat — dodge the circle.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Volibear's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Drop Hallowed Mist as he commits: Thundering Smash stuns the first enemy he ATTACKS, and untargetable there is nobody to attack.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Thundering Smash's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — long mist duels out-heal a Frenzied Maul on its 5s cooldown.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Volibear carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: You own the 1v1 forever. Respect Stormbringer only: it disables your towers, so never fight under a turret you rely on.

edits.before: - Volibear Thundering Smash: matchup-defining — His engage. Mist or dodge the stun. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Volibear Thundering Smash (10-12s): stuns the first enemy he ATTACKS, so deny him a target. - Frenzied Maul (5s): the heal is on the second cast into the same mark. - Sky Splitter (16s): slow plus a shield if he stands in it.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Volibear with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Volibear wastes Thundering Smash (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Volibear with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Thundering Smash expires without an attack — he has no stun for 10-12s, so commit the full pattern. Bad trade: staying in Frenzied Maul range long enough for the second cast to land, which is the only part that heals him.

edits.before: His engage. Mist or dodge the stun. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It stuns the first enemy he attacks — deny him the target and it expires.

edits.before: Volibear wastes Thundering Smash (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul heals only on its second cast into the same marked target.

edits.before: That is Volibear's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is 10-12s and it is his only hard CC. Do not walk into it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Break off after the first Maul and the re-cast heal never lands.

edits.before: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Sky Splitter shields him if he stands inside his own blast — never trade with him inside that circle.

edits.before: Track Volibear's Thundering Smash (Stun): His engage. Mist or dodge the stun. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Thundering Smash stuns the first enemy he attacks; Frenzied Maul heals only on the second cast into a mark.

edits.before: W-mist his stun all-in — anti-heal and Snip his HP. Gwen wins by trading around Volibear's Thundering Smash and cashing the pattern: w-mist his all-in and Snip his HP.
edits.after: Deny Thundering Smash a target and break off before the second Frenzied Maul — that re-cast is his only heal. Then snip his HP down from inside the mist.

edits.before: Hallowed Mist plus Needlework lets you blank his all-in: drop the mist as his E fling lands so the Q-dash bite follow-up has nothing to chase, stand inside untargetable, then R-slow and snip him down.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist plus Needlework blanks his all-in: Thundering Smash stuns the first enemy he attacks, so drop the mist as he closes and, untargetable, there is nobody for him to attack. Then R-slow and snip.

edits.before: His one threat window before your mist: a stacked passive auto into Q-dash and E fling can chain-CC and burst you with no Hallowed Mist to hide in — respect it, and don't sit in W-bite range.
edits.after: His one threat window before your mist: a stacked passive auto into Thundering Smash and a Sky Splitter slow can pin and burst you with no Hallowed Mist to hide in — never sit in Frenzied Maul range.

edits.before: Land his E hand-of-the-god fling to yank you out of mist range, then chain the Q-dash bite before your cooldowns reset
edits.after: Land Sky Splitter (E) to slow you out of mist range, then chain Thundering Smash's stun before your cooldowns reset

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a coinflip until you hit 6 — he can Q-dash in and E-fling you into a bite with no Hallowed Mist to save you, so play around that engage cooldown and don't facecheck. At 6 it's yours: when he commits the E fling and W bite all-in, drop the mist right as the fling lands so his follow-up loses the target, stand untargetable while you R-slow him, and keep snipping. Your per-ability healing off his big HP bar out-sustains his W bite heal in any extended fight.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a coinflip until you hit 6 — he can Thundering Smash in and Sky Splitter you into a Frenzied Maul with no Hallowed Mist to save you, so play around that 10-12 second engage cooldown and don't facecheck. At 6 it's yours: Thundering Smash stuns the first enemy he attacks, so drop the mist as he closes and, untargetable, he has nobody to hit. Stand in it, R-slow him, and keep snipping. Your per-ability healing off his big HP bar out-sustains a Frenzied Maul re-cast in any extended fight.

edits.before: Pre-6 his Q-dash into E fling can chain CC and bite you with no Hallowed Mist to escape, but you can sidestep the engage and punish the whiff — a real skill test either way.
edits.after: Pre-6 Thundering Smash into a Sky Splitter slow can pin and maul you with no Hallowed Mist to escape, but you can sidestep the engage and punish the whiff — a real skill test either way.

edits.before: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist lets you blank his E-fling all-in inside the fog so the bite has no target, then R-slow and snip him out untargetable.
edits.after: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist blanks his all-in: Thundering Smash stuns the first enemy he attacks, and untargetable in the fog there is nobody for him to attack.

notes: The content layer invented a Volibear displacement — an 'E fling' / 'hand-of-the-god fling' that yanks Gwen out of mist range — and built the level 4-6 advice around it in four places. Sky Splitter is a lightning bolt that slows and shields him; there is no displacement in his kit. The genuinely useful facts (Thundering Smash's stun rides an attack, so untargetability denies it; Frenzied Maul heals only on the second cast into the same mark) were both absent.
